panels.scene: A long warehouse shelf of numbered boxes, 0 to 15, labels in ascending order.
panels.dialogue: Every box has a number. I don't search — I jump.

panels.scene: Mentor stands at the middle box, box 7, holding a clipboard with the target value 54.
panels.dialogue: The shelf is sorted. So I start in the middle, not at the left.

panels.scene: Box 7 opens to reveal 45. The left half of the shelf fades to grey.
panels.dialogue: 45 is smaller than 54. Everything to the left is smaller too. Gone.

panels.scene: Mentor opens box 11, the middle of the remaining boxes 8 to 15. It holds 61. Boxes 11 to 15 fade to grey.
panels.dialogue: 61 is too big. Everything right of it is bigger. Halve again.

panels.scene: Box 9, the middle of boxes 8 to 10, opens to reveal 54, glowing amber.
panels.dialogue: Found in three looks out of sixteen boxes. That's log n.

panels.scene: Mentor points at a messy unsorted shelf beside the neat one.
panels.dialogue: On this unsorted shelf, the trick fails. Sorted first, or no halving.
